# MonsterX AI by Xone AI

> MonsterX AI is a powerful AI assistant developed by Xone AI. It offers conversational AI chat, AI image generation, and smart content assistance for users worldwide. Available on web, free with premium plans.

## About
- **Product Name:** MonsterX AI
- **Company:** Xone AI
- **Website:** https://www.xoneai.in
- **Category:** AI Assistant / Chatbot / Generative AI
- **Launch:** 2025
- **Availability:** Web (Global)
- **Languages:** English, Hindi, and more

## Key Features
- Real-time conversational AI chat
- AI image generation
- Smart content assistance and writing help
- Multi-language support
- File and image upload analysis
- Voice input support
- Chat history and memory

## Pricing
MonsterX AI offers a free tier with premium paid plans. See https://www.xoneai.in/pricing for current pricing and features.

## Use Cases
- Customer support automation
- Content creation and copywriting
- Coding assistance
- Image generation for design and marketing
- Educational tutoring
- Research assistance

## Technical
- **Frontend:** React + Vite
- **Backend:** FastAPI (Python)
- **Auth:** JWT + Google OAuth
- **Payments:** Razorpay, PhonePe
